comment: The store builds of the extension that a release host lets in. Each entry is chrome-extension://<32-letter id>/ with the trailing slash. Put the Chrome Web Store id in chrome_web_store and the Edge Add-ons id in edge_add_ons once each listing exists. While both lists are empty, build-release-local.ps1 ships the app without the host. It refuses a list holding the development id from allowed-origins.dev.json or anything but a plain extension origin, and the host's --check-release refuses a host with no store id.
